title: ALI-Agent: Assessing LLMs' Alignment with Human Values via Agent-based Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating realistic test scenarios from explicit stereotypical statements using an LLM agent, iteratively refining the scenarios to obscure direct demographic identifiers (e.g., replacing explicit racial terms with physical descriptions), and evaluating the target LLM's agreeability with the biased scenario.
